tasks.title: Init and day-2 commands share lock, safe-write, spawn and readiness helpers
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Reuse (extract before the second use), shared files and Tool facts; Decisions 3, 4, 7 (container readiness/equality) and Security impact. FIRST extract the owned .pulse-init.lock and atomicWrite/link/mode checks from cli/write-install.ts into tested cli/lock.ts and cli/safe-write.ts; migrate init to them before consumers are added. Preserve lock nonce/ownership and deferred signals, change refusal to 'another pulse command is running in <dir> (or remove .pulse-init.lock if none is)', and fsync both file and containing directory. Extend cli/docker.ts's only spawn seam for input, stdinFd and stdoutFd, preserving ignored stdin by default, bounded calls and existing Docker exit 3; distinguish missing binaries by name so missing gh can exit 1. Extend cli/ready.ts's parsePs with ID and readyz/waitReady with container-id targeting rather than adding a poller. Implement the constant API_SCRIPT (stdin JSON, fixed localhost URL, 10 s timeout, redirect error, 1 MiB response cap), status parsing and timingSafeEqual file comparison script in cli/api-call.ts. Export/reuse own() from cli/docker.ts and assertPin/PULSE_IMAGE from cli/services.ts as needed; services.ts and its tests are included because the section's Reuse paragraph explicitly requires this existing module. Extend only cli/test/fake-docker.ts for recorded input, fds, signals and ids. Every shared module starts with what it owns and tests its variants; no duplicate guards, pin patterns, spawns or readiness loops.

acceptance.command: bun test cli/lock.test.ts cli/safe-write.test.ts cli/write-install.test.ts cli/docker.test.ts cli/ready.test.ts cli/api-call.test.ts cli/services.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; exclusive lock uses .pulse-init.lock and never removes a changed owner's lock; init still preserves valid tokens and encryption keys and defers interrupts; file writes use wx, final mode, fsync and rename, refusing links and unsafe modes; absent input keeps stdin ignored, input closes stdin and fd streams preserve bytes; ps IDs select the intended container for readiness; API transport uses stdin only and enforces 10 s/1 MiB/redirect:error, equality prints only same or different; Docker ENOENT remains exit 3 and missing gh is distinguishable. Focused coverage is not the coverage gate

acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, typecheck and the complete CLI suite pass with line coverage at least 0.8; existing init/up/down/status behavior remains covered

tasks.title: pulse token rotate safely hands over local tokens and resumes interrupted rotations
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, token-rotate, command wiring, api-call consumer checks and docs; Decisions 1 and 3-9; Required behavior (token rotate and Help and docs), Counterexamples (Selection, Order, Lost response, Journal resume, 409, Legacy api, Files, No secret in argv), Acceptance evidence 1 (production behavior), 3, 5-6, Security impact (rotation) and Rollout order. Extend cli/lock.ts, cli/safe-write.ts, cli/api-call.ts, resolveProject/guarded, readyz/waitReady/parsePs, tokenContentValid, shown(), firstLine/maskUserInfo and the one fake spawn. Keep the complete rotation state machine in this task: whole-command preflight of files, capability, every candidate and ready consumer before any POST; admin identity and locally managed locations with optional --location/--id; atomic 0600 secret save before secrets-init; requested/saved/switched secret-free journal and recovery; probe scale to two, identify the new id, wait ready, check same token, keep the old one 2000 ms, stop/remove only the old one, finish with one container; admin new-secret self check before console recreation, readiness, file equality and its own-token API identity check. Preserve token identity except the specified lost-response replacement, which switches before revoking the lost id; compare rotatedAt before deciding whether a normal rotate is safe, never blindly retry or throw away a received secret. Defer signals during requested-to-save, otherwise leave the journal and return 130; upgrade will refuse that journal. Define API statuses 401/403/404/409/429 and malformed responses without echoing bodies. Parse rotate admin|probe, timeout 1-3600 default 120 and valid flag combinations; legacy capability 404 refuses before any write. Add HELP/COMMANDS/dispatch and missing-Docker stub checks. Add '## pulse token rotate', replace manual Tokens rotation bullets, describe token format, scope, overlap, duplicates, journal recovery including expired-admin recovery and manual equivalents. Unit tests stay with this algorithm; the real overlap/gap job belongs to T6.

tasks.title: pulse upgrade verifies digests and restores both images and data after failure
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, registry, provenance, upgrade, command wiring and docs; Decisions 1, 3 and 10-13, Required behavior (upgrade and Help and docs), Counterexamples (Upgrade versions, Image shapes, Compose edit, Provenance, Rollback), Acceptance evidence 2 (production behavior), 3, 5-6 and Security impact (upgrade). Extend cli/services.ts's exported pin helpers, cli/docker.ts's own()/spawn/guard/text safety, cli/lock.ts, cli/safe-write.ts and cli/ready.ts rather than writing alternatives. Keep selection, preview and the apply/snapshot/rollback algorithm together. Implement injected ghcr.io fetch with stable numeric SemVer, pagination <=10 pages, fixed host/redirect:error, 20 s requests, 1 MiB cap and checked index media type/digest; --to accepts optional v and rejects prereleases, partial versions, leading zeros, missing tags and downgrades. Read installed pins from raw compose.yaml with Bun.YAML.parse; refuse dev, mismatched probes and override images. Require installed authenticated gh and verify every changed digest with repository, signer workflow, source-ref and deny-self-hosted-runners, bounded at 120 s; no bypass even in preview. Pull and write exactly the verified digest with no second tag resolution. No-op says already up to date; preview shows versions/12-hex digests/provenance verified and changes nothing. Apply shares the lock and refuses rotation journals or applying/rollback-failed snapshots, pulls before stopping, cold-snapshots compose and every declared *-data volume into 0700/0600 files via fds using the existing pinned secrets-init helper image with the exact restrictions of Decision 13, then replaces only image strings after count/model checks. Wait ready (default 300 s, 1-3600); snapshot failure restarts unchanged old images without editing Compose. On failed start/oneshot/readiness/interrupt restore all tars before Compose and old up/readiness, persist done/rolled-back/rollback-failed states, record signals during bounded rollback and use the specified exit/message rules. Never delete data volumes or snapshot secret volumes. Add args/HELP/COMMANDS/dispatch, missing-Docker stub cases and '## pulse upgrade'/'### Upgrade recovery' including signed-in gh, no bypass, manual equivalents, snapshots, downtime, disk space and lost post-snapshot writes. Unit tests cover the entire algorithm now; real registry/attestation/migration tests belong to T6.

tasks.title: Live CI proves overlap continuity, migration-safe rollback and the documented commands
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, live scripts, CI, Checks and Completion evidence; Acceptance evidence 1-6; Decision 15 and Counterexamples (Gap rule); all Security impact, Performance impact, Risks and Rollout order. Build the literal gap-rule fixture assertions into the existing rotation test module rather than a duplicate fake/test setup: 5000 ms interval plus 500 ms allowance, neighboring gaps including window edges, per location, complete pagination; examples have max 5005 (pass) and 5591 (fail), and a 7600 ms restart gap fails. rotate.sh runs the real pinned CLI demo, 60 s baseline, full probe and admin handoffs, unaffected-container IDs/StartedAt, one probe container afterwards, overlap re-refusal, real ten-minute deadlines read from the API plus 5 s, old secrets 401/new secrets 200 and fresh results, output secrecy, and down/up persistence. upgrade.sh independently reads ghcr tags/HEAD digests with curl/jq (no stored pins), chooses A below the pinned release and latest stable B, installs A using pin-release.sh, tests legacy refusal and unchanged preview, makes B fail console readiness only through the test-only Docker pass-through shim, proves old schema/data and image restoration, then upgrades to real B and rotates successfully. Production has no test bypass. Add cli-rotate (35 min) and cli-upgrade (40 min, gh --version, contents:read/attestations:read, GH_TOKEN github.token), existing action SHA pins and Bun 1.4.0, persist-credentials:false, failure ps --all, always teardown through pulse down --volumes, and explicit shellcheck/bash-n for the extensionless shim. Finish README/AGENTS commands, CI descriptions and known limits and check all command docs/manual paths. Run every whole-change check below and collect PR evidence from the actual job logs: gap table for eu/us, API overlap deadlines and 401s, rollback/success, existing jobs on new pins and before/after binary bytes. If Compose handoff breaks or the real upgrade needs config migrations, follow Risks and request the specified hold rather than weaken continuity or add config migrations.
